section: 7-Eleven case study results: faster communication with field operations after the AVI-SPL installation
body:
The reported impact of AVI-SPL's conference room project at the 7-Eleven Store Support Center in Irving. This is legacy-platform proof: the results relate to Skype Meetings and the Polycom conferencing system, the older platforms named on the page.

**What changed for staff**

- Staff can walk into a room, connect a laptop and start collaborating with a single button press, whether their peers are in the room or across the country.
- Before the install, communicating with field operations might have taken half a day to a day. Now staff look at a colleague's calendar, check availability, set up a Skype Meeting and share content in real time.
- Harvey Dewitt of 7-Eleven said this lets the team be more flexible, more mobile and more fluid in the field.

**Collaboration between departments and the field**

- The video collaboration solutions are described as breaking down silos, with instant communication and real-time feedback among departments and the field operations team.
- Department heads at the 30-plus corporate sites use the Polycom conferencing system to share HD video and documents.
- With Polycom RealConnect, a user opens the calendar, picks a meeting time, invites attendees and rooms, and sends a single invite.
- Dewitt said it helps departments set up meetings where they share content, address needs and identify opportunities to improve; a person walks in, pushes one button and is ready. He also praised being able to interact with presenters on video calls and the high-resolution quality of presented documents.
- Better and faster communication with the field consultants has taken a burden off the operations team, leaving it more time to support franchisees.

**Adjustments during rollout**

- As AVI-SPL integrated the solutions, 7-Eleven watched how the first users interacted with the new systems. That led to adjustments to improve the user experience. JT Elliott of 7-Eleven said AVI-SPL was there to change things on the fly.

**Customer view of AVI-SPL**

- Elliott said AVI-SPL has been more than an integrator and has become a partner that values what 7-Eleven wants to do as a business, and that 7-Eleven could not imagine using another integrator for this project.

**When to use this**

For customers asking what outcomes a standardized, one-button meeting room rollout produced for a retail organization with field operations.

**Not stated in this source**: measured adoption or usage figures, cost savings, and any results on current platforms.
